$comment: Per-repo settings for the usiatech-engineering plugin. Copy to .claude/engineering.json and adjust.

tickets.$comment: Ticket tracker for to-tickets, approve-plan and release: "github" (the default) or "jira". For Jira set tracker to "jira" and add "jira": {"site": "https://example.atlassian.net", "project": "ESP", "issueType": "Subtask", "parent": "ESP-27" (optional), "statuses": {"started": "In Progress", "merged": "Ready for Release", "released": "Released"} (each optional)}. Credentials come only from the JIRA_EMAIL and JIRA_API_TOKEN environment variables; the token is sent only to an .atlassian.net site or the JIRA_SITE host. Jira failures are never retried and never undo git steps. See the README under Jira tracker and ADR 0003.

governance.$comment: Guard settings. Commands are case-insensitive regexes. Defaults already cover destructive git/SQL/rm, curl|sh, --no-verify, dependency adds, remote/infra commands, secrets reads and sudo. allowlist suppresses one workflow/dependency finding by rule ID plus a path glob or package name (still reported, never blocks); a wf-* entry needs one literal file path and can't cover wf-unparsed, otherwise it suppresses nothing and is reported as wf-allowlist-ignored, e.g. {"rule": "wf-unpinned-action", "path": ".github/workflows/pr-governance.yml", "reason": "..."} or {"rule": "sc-install-script", "package": "esbuild", "reason": "postinstall only fetches its platform binary"}; it ships empty. trustedWritePaths (writes outside the project that don't ask, still logged as trusted; the values shown are the defaults, [] asks again) and planEdits ("allow" lets plan edits that only change evidence, task ticks or the change log through; "ask" asks for every plan edit; "all" trusts every plan and archive write, still logged, so the governance-reviewer becomes the only scope check on plan changes) are explained in the README under Trusted writes. approvalLabel and requirementRefPattern (null = default C-number/FR/AC/ADR/D-item/§/#issue) are also used by the PR governance workflow.
